lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Hi, Rookie. You’re late.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Oh no. She noticed. Do I tell her about the guard? Or do I just apologize?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: The guard wouldn't let me in, Ma'am.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The guard? Good. That means he's doing his job.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We have standards here at The Paragon.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: If you can't present proper required, well...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: ...requirements, you can't be trusted with a headline.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Since you're the new encoder, let's see if you can follow simple instructions.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: I need your staff profile for the digital database.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Just... type my name and bio?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Not just 'type,' Rookie. Format.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Formatting isn't just about looking pretty. It's how you guide the reader's eyes.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Put your Header and Name in 18pt Arial. It's clean and bold—people can read it from across the room.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Keep your role and department at 14pt Arial so they don't fight with your name.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: And use 12pt Times New Roman for your bio. Those little feet on the letters help tired eyes read long sentences without getting lost.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don't mix random fonts like a messy poster. Every choice has a reason.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: That's your desk over there. Big Arial for headers, Times New Roman for your bio. Don't make me pull out my red pen on your first day. Go.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Hmmmm… I gotta say, not bad for a Rookie.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Well done. Let's see how you did.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: [FEEDBACK]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Well, that should be it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Dismissed.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Did the guard see you? You should really get yourself an Application Form first.
